name: auth-oauth
summary: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect single sign-on (Google, Microsoft, Okta...)
description:
Adds OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) based single sign-on to jPulse Framework. Supports public sites (Google) and org-internal sites (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, ADFS via generic OIDC discovery), plus manual OAuth2 for non-OIDC providers.

  • Authorization Code Flow with PKCE: mandatory PKCE (S256), state, and OIDC nonce on every provider
  • Flexible User Linking: sub-only, link-by-email, or just-in-time account creation, per provider
  • Composes with MFA: auth-mfa's TOTP step runs after successful SSO identity resolution
author: jPulse Team <team@jpulse.net>

schema.help: For JIT-created users only. If the IdP doesn't provide these claims, the user is prompted to fill them in at first login. Existing users are never re-prompted.

schema.content: Break-Glass: If you set configuration controller.auth.localAuthRestriction: 'admins-only' in site/webapp/app.conf, non-admin users must use SSO. Local admins can still sign in with username/password (recovery via /auth/login.shtml?localFallback=1).
